Guts tells him about the cure that Balzac has promised him, but Dunteth cannot stand the idea of having to negotiate with the very tyrant he's been rebelling against. It is only his wife and Rita's persuading that make him change his mind, and agree to accompany Guts to the infested village in search of the heart of the great tree. Mr. Exposition: Explains the perspective of Balzac's subjects to Guts as a corrective to Balzac's self-serving narrative. Rebel Leader: Leads the underground resistance of the commoners against Balzac's rule. Ugly Guy, Hot Wife: Dunteth looks middle-aged and rather homely while his wife, though plain, is noticeably younger and better-looking than him.

characters.name: Eriza
characters.description: Eriza (エリザEriza) is a nun who lives in a village inhabited entirely by Mandragorans, and seems to be the only human who coexists with them. After replanting the mandrake that one of Dunteth's men unwittingly uprooted, she accuses Guts of killing the Mandragorans needlessly and tries to explain and defend the mandragorans' behavior to him. Recounting the tragic story of a boy named Nico whom all the villagers turned away when he was cold and starving, she asserts that the Mandragorans are innocent and harmless as long as they and their flowers are not disturbed, and entreats Guts to leave them alone. Rita objects that if left alone the mandragora will only spread and infect everyone, but Eriza insists the Mandragoran's peaceful and happy existence should be embraced rather than the lives of violence and suffering that most humans lead. After failing to persuade them, Eriza retreats to the Church. Anti-Villain: There's not a cruel bone in her body; everything she does is because of love. Still, she's an antagonist to Guts because she refuses to let him take the heart of the great tree. Better to Die than Be Killed:Finding that Gyove and his henchmen have massacred the mandragorans, burned down the village, and are coming for her next, she dives into the burning church with Nico in her arms to prevent the heart of the great tree from falling into the humans' hands. Blue-and-Orange Morality: Argues that the Mandragorans shouldn't be blamed for killing people who have unwittingly uprooted their flowers, since they never use violence unless they are attacked first or their taboo is broken, and that humans should join them instead of trying to exterminate them. Botanical Abomination:When Guts faces Nico, she reveals that she too was a mandragoran all along.

characters.name: Nico
characters.description: Nico (ニコNiko) was a simple-minded young boy who lived as a vagrant in the village where Eriza's church stands, apparently with no family or companions except for his loyal dog. Theother villagers never seemed to like him, often resorting to beating him with sticks and stones.He eventually became an Apostle, taking the form of a Mandragora tree. All of the Other Reindeer: He was a pariah at the village, with only Eriza seeming to care for him. Botanical Abomination:His Apostle body consists of two stalks ending in Venus flytrap mouths, and what remains of his human body stands like the stamen in the middle of a giant flower covered with eyes. Canine Companion: He's shown having had a puppy once.Using the Behelit requires one to sacrifice one close to him. The dog never appears again outside the flashback, possibly implying he sacrificed it. Cheerful Child: No matter what his misfortune, he always smiled.

characters.name: Charles
characters.description: Charles (シャルルSharuru) is a young noble who used to live happily in a beautiful mansion with his parents and his sister, Marien. One day, attackers burned the mansion down and killed everyone inside, except for Charles and Marien who escaped. In the ruins of their home, Charles found a Behelit that he used to turn himself into an Apostle and reclaim what he had lost, creating an illusory world of his own where he could live with Marien undisturbed. However, he either lost or repressed his memory of what he gave to the God Hand as a sacrifice. Many years later, Guts, Casca, and Puck happen upon his mansion, and Guts enters the Great Hall despite Charles' voice warning him to turn back. Charles curses Guts for shattering his world with his presence and causes the Band of the Hawk to appear before Guts and fight him. When Guts meets him again in Qliphoth, Charles explains that the Hawks are projections of the fears and regrets inside of Guts' heart, and fights him using his magical powers after Guts succeeds in defeating the apparitions. Guts figures out based on what Charles has told him that he sacrificed his sister in order to become an Apostle, and that the girl following Charles is merely a shadow of Marien that he created. When Guts spells it out to him, Charles refuses to accept the truth, transforming into his butterfly-shaped Apostle form as he screams that he's going to kill Guts. Guts mortally wound him in their battle, and Charles dies while slipping back into the illusion he created in his mind. Adult Hater: Charles despises adults, trusting nobody except his sister Marien, and calls Guts no different from the ones who ruined his life. Alas, Poor Villain: Even though he was irredeemably evil and needed to be put down, his death is depicted as sad and pathetic because beneath it all he was just a child who couldn't bear the loss of his home and family. Awful Truth: Sacrificed Marien, but deluded himself into thinking she was still with him. When Guts tells h

characters.name: Fate Graphite
characters.description: The protagonist. He lost his father in the past and was simultaneously driven out of his village. He ends up in the royal capital, but is unable to find a decent job and is employed as a day laborer for a meager wage by a Holy Knight of the Vlerick house, one of the five great noble families, to act as a substitute for the castle gatekeeper. He had always thought of himself as a worthless person because his level never increased, his stats were low, and he had the useless skill "Gluttony" which only caused him to be constantly hungry. However, when he finished off a wounded bandit who attacked the castle, he learned the true effect of "Gluttony": that it steals the skills and stats of the people he has killed. Anti-Hero: He does not hesitate to kill monsters and criminals to steal their skills and points to satisfy his hunger but he uses his power to protect the innocent and do the right thing morally. An Arm and a Leg: He allows Northern to sever his left arm so he can get an opening and stab Northern in the back. He later gets his arm restored with Greed's regenerative ability. Bad Powers, Good People: His skill is the mortal sin gluttony which he uses to satisfy his hunger by killing monsters and criminals but he is not a villain and actively avoids being evil. Because You Were Nice to Me: He becomes attached to Roxy because she saved him many times and accepts his power.

characters.name: Greed
characters.description: Anti-Magic: Scythe form can cut though magic. Cast from Experience Points: Greed can absorb its user stats to activate its abilities. In fact, just to be its rightful owner requires the user to give up all of their current stats to it just to unlock Bow mode, and special attacks require at least 10%. For anyone else, this isAwesome, but Impracticalbut for Fate who can absorb stats, it's a blessing. Cross Attack: The sword is shaped like a cross. Dark Is Not Evil: Greed is black sword with a strange twisted design. However he is generally quite amiable and helpful to Fate, despite teasing him occasionally. Equippable Ally: He is a weapon and indispensable ally to Fate.

characters.name: Roxy Hart
characters.description: First Girl Wins: Roxy is the first of Fate's love interests whom he meets and he stays devoted to her throughout the series. Hair of Gold, Heart of Gold: Roxy is a blonde, and she's also kind towards other people. Innocent Blue Eyes: To complement her blonde hair, she has clear blue eyes. Her naivety sometimes shows itself, such as when Fate accidentally overhears her inner thoughts about how she's never linked arms with a boy before meeting Fate. Knight in Shining Armor: A member of the Holy Knights, Roxy holds the belief that the strong must be punished and the weak rescued. Living Emotional Crutch: To Fate. Roxy is the only reason why he can keep the Gluttony skill from turning him into an insane killing machine. She also stops him from trying to end his life when he fears Gluttony will completely corrupt him.

characters.name: Myne
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: Eris mentions she and Myne don't get along because Myne is jealous of Eris' large breasts. Big Eater: She has a huge appetite. Fate even jokes about her being more suited to be the Gluttony wielder than him. The Big Girl: She's the strongest physical fighter among the main characters. Cast from Calories: Her Wrath skill burns a lot of calories, which is why she's always hungry. Emotionless Girl: Despite possessing the Wrath skill, she normally doesn't show much emotion.

characters.name: Eris Seifort
characters.description: Buxom Beauty Standard: Her large bust is one of the reasons why many are easily charmed by her. Charm Person: The "Lust" skill allows her to charm and captivate people. Really 700 Years Old: She's over 4,000 years old.

characters.name: Rafale Vlerick
characters.description: The eldest son of Vlerick Family. He was Fate's lead tormentor among the Holy Knights. Bastard Bastard: He's the bastard son that the head of the Vlerick family had from an affair with a commoner. Hates Their Parent:He absolutely hates his father for murdering his mother. Jerkass: He's cruel and abusive to everyone around him. No Sympathy: He doesn't feels sympathy about his brother, Hado's death.

characters.name: Hado Vlerick
characters.description: The second son of the Vlerick Family. An Arm and a Leg: Fate severs his arms and legs. Jerkass: He's every bit as much of an abusive jerk as Rafale. Karmic Death: Roxy, due to the Vlerick siblings' scheming, is chosen to go to Galia to finish the mission that killed her father. In retribution, Fate takes revenge on Hado, destroys his holy sword, beats him severely and then kills him, stealing his skill Holy Sword Technique.

characters.name: Memil Vlerick
characters.description: The youngest of the three siblings of the Vlerick Family. Guinea Pig Family:After she's betrayed by Rafale and Hado, she's turned into a Nightwalker as a result of the experimentation done to her by her eldest brother Rafale. High-Heel–Face Turn: She's the only Vlerick who redeems herself and realizes her errors ever since her brothers' betrayal towards her. Meido: She becomes a maid to the Barbatos family after being saved by Fate and Aaron. Ojou Ringlets: She has the classical ringlet hairstyle and is the daughter of one of the five esteemed families in Seifort.

characters.name: Mason Hart
characters.description: Deceased Parents Are the Best: Roxy remembers him as a loving father and a noble Holy Knight. Disappeared Dad: He lost his life during a mission to subjugate monsters in Galia. Uptown Guy: His wife Aisha used to be a commoner before he married her.

characters.name: Aisha Hart
characters.description: Delicate and Sickly: Her physical condition is weak because she's severely ill. She couldn't be cured even with the position and financial power from Hart family. But thanks to Greed's Twilight Healing, Aisha recovers. Motherly Side Plait: She wears a braid over her left shoulder, since mothers in anime commonly have this hairstyle. Shipper on Deck: She notices Roxy's feelings for Fate and asks him to continue supporting her daughter.

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: The head maid of the Hart Family. She is also Roxy's secretary. Meido: She works as the chief maid of the Hart family. Stoic Spectacles: She wears glasses and has a calm, no-nonsense personality.

characters.name: Set
characters.description: The son of the village elder in Fate's hometown. He visited the city to hire a warrior to defeat the monsters attacking the village, as instructed by his father, but was ignored because his money offer was too low. Tthat's when he reunited with Fate and he asks Fate to help the village after seeing how strong he has become. Good Parents: He has a daughter who he has a loving relationship with. Reformed Bully: He used to bully Fate when they were children. Years later, Set has grown as a person and is now an honest person and not cruel, unlike his father. He genuinely expresses regret over his bullying of Fate when they meet again as adults.

characters.name: Aaron Barbatos
characters.description: A former Holy Knight and the head of the Barbatos family, one of the five great noble families. While away on a mission, his territory was attacked and occupied by a Lich Lord. Unable to intervene because his family and villagers, who had been turned into undead, were used as human shields, he retired from being a Holy Knight. He moved to a village where people with nowhere else to go gathered, and he ended up taking on a role similar to that of a village chief. My Greatest Failure: His family were killed by a Lich Lord while he was away to Galia due to his duties as a Holy Knight. Red Baron: He's also known as the Sword Saint.

characters.name: Luna
characters.description: A Galian girl who was turned into the core of a chimera named Chimera Haniel. Fate Worse than Death: She was turned into a chimera and spent centuries suffering after losing her humanity. She even thanks Fate for killing her and putting her out of her misery. Godiva Hair: After being transformed into a chimera, her hair cover her naked breasts. Was Once a Man: She was a human girl who was experimented on and transformed into a chimera.
